title: Beyond Static Structures: New Opportunities to Model the Dynamic Interactions of Cell-Surface Proteins.
journal: Chembiochem : a European journal of chemical biology
one_liner_zh: 该文综述细胞表面蛋白动态相互作用建模的挑战与机遇，强调MD信息机器学习、生成模型和多尺度模拟，与蛋白质构象采样和结构预测计算课题高度相关但偏展望性综述。
abstract: Recent advances in AI-driven structure prediction have transformed structural biology but remain limited for cell-surface proteins mediating transient, context-dependent interactions. Multidomain architectures, flexible linkers, and coupled cis- and trans-interactions challenge current models, leading to inaccurate predictions for key adhesion molecules. These limitations highlight the need to incorporate cellular context, conformational dynamics, and multivalent interactions. Emerging strategies, including MD-informed machine learning, generative models, and multiscale simulations integrated with experimental restraints, offer promising solutions. Together, these approaches aim to bridge static structure prediction with dynamic, physiologically relevant modeling of protein interactions at cell-cell interfaces.
abstract_zh: 近期，AI驱动的结构预测进展已改变了结构生物学，但对于介导瞬时的、依赖环境的相互作用的细胞表面蛋白而言，仍存在局限。多结构域架构、柔性连接区以及耦合的顺式（cis）和反式（trans）相互作用对当前模型构成挑战，导致对关键黏附分子的预测不准确。这些局限凸显了纳入细胞环境、构象动力学和多价相互作用的必要性。新兴策略，包括分子动力学（molecular dynamics, MD）信息驱动的机器学习、生成模型以及与实验约束整合的多尺度模拟，提供了有前景的解决方案。总之，这些方法旨在将静态结构预测与细胞-细胞界面处蛋白质相互作用的动态、生理相关建模衔接起来。
